name: GOG Builds (GOGDB)
shortDescription: Tracks GOG build history and suggests editions using the community-run GOGDB archive.
description:
Tracks the build history of GOG products and suggests their editions.
Data comes from the community-run GOGDB archive (gogdb.org), which is not an official GOG API.
This plugin cannot search for games. Enable another GOG store plugin to search; without one, products can only be added by ID or URL.
